prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1214; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with immediate complaints of neck pain and restricted cervical range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the crash, and the presenting symptoms align well with a cervical strain. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to the neck or upper back. Over the course of care, the patient completed 28 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of injury, with gradual improvement in range of motion and pain levels. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing entries. Current status shows partial resolution of symptoms, and the provider recommends continued home exercise and periodic reassessment as needed.
